name: David
summary: A shepherd from Bethlehem whom the LORD chose to be king of Israel. He killed Goliath, spared Saul when he could have killed him, and reigned forty years from Hebron and Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Anointed by Samuel
key_moments.description: The LORD sent Samuel to Bethlehem, telling him the LORD looks on the heart. Jesse's youngest son David was brought in from the sheep, Samuel anointed him, and the Spirit of the LORD came upon him.

key_moments.title: Kills Goliath
key_moments.description: David came to the camp and heard Goliath mock the armies of God. He went out with a sling and five stones, saying the battle was the LORD's, and struck the Philistine in the forehead with a stone.

key_moments.title: Sparing Saul's Life
key_moments.description: In a cave near Engedi, David cut off a piece of Saul's robe but would not harm him, because Saul was the LORD's anointed. Saul wept and said David would surely be king.

key_moments.title: Made King over All Israel
key_moments.description: All the tribes came to David at Hebron and anointed him king over Israel. He took the stronghold of Zion, which became the city of David, and reigned forty years in all.

key_moments.title: Rebuked by Nathan for Taking Bathsheba
key_moments.description: David took Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, and had Uriah put where he would die in battle. The prophet Nathan told him a story of a stolen lamb and showed him the man was David, and David confessed his sin against the LORD.
